source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send OEM command to set FAN speed : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x21 0x00
2. Check all FAN speed in chassis

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. FAN speed in SDR should be 20%
     0h = Auto Control (follow fan control algorithm).

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- FAN speed Auto mode: switch fan speed back to auto mode ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" raw 0x30 0x30 0x01 0x01 2>&1 and confirm fans return to temperature-driven control ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "FAN|SPD".
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the switch response + the fan sensors so the user confirms auto-mode is re-armed and fan speeds follow temperature.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL substitutes 0x30/0x30 for Master 0x30/0x21, exposes credentials and checks fan lines without an authoritative control-state query, thermal watchdog or bounded recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly treats auto restoration as CRITICAL state change requiring command resolution, explicit approval, state proof and thermal monitoring.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 976/2291 requires operator presence but accepts unresolved command and 20% semantics.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The preceding manual-duty test makes auto restoration essential; the following read-only Get case may provide state evidence but cannot itself restore control.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 requires approved OEM commands; ED-35 preserves real auto-mode behavior rather than fixed-value read-only substitution; ED-36 treats safe inputs as readiness; ED-38 forbids automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved OEM operation returns the platform from manual override to automatic temperature-driven fan control and leaves every fan in a safe recovered state.
original_method: After explicit approval, capture the current override and thermal baseline, issue the single vendor-approved auto command, verify an authoritative auto-state signal plus temperature-dependent fan behavior, and confirm no override/alarm remains.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE chooses the authoritative auto command/state query and defines whether 20% is a minimum, display convention or error. Operator confirms target/abort path before the change; engineer decides recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Baseline override and complete fan map
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs or expose credentials.
Do not choose between conflicting raw command families without owner approval.
Require independent RPM/temperature/alarm monitoring and bounded timeout.
Verify auto state through a control-state signal and observed closed-loop response, not one 20% reading.
Stop on failure or anomaly, preserve evidence and do not automatically retry.
agent_execution_scope: Static review validates the approved auto-mode runbook/evidence only.
If separately authorized, capture override, fan and thermal baseline.
Issue the one approved auto command and monitor all mapped fans/temperatures.
Query state and verify no override/alarm remains over the approved interval.
Return evidence without self-approval or retry.
engineer_actions: Authorize the run and issue final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unapproved substitution: a different OEM command family, password-bearing CLI and grep output cannot prove auto state or safe recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the platform owner's pinned auto command plus independent read-state query within an approved thermal watchdog and timeout runbook.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master raw command, 20%/0h Criterion, Script and 20/10-minute values remain preserved for engineer resolution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one approved auto-restoration operation with state-signal and closed-loop thermal proof under staffed interlocks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact fan controller/BMC firmware covered by the approved command.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, OEM command spec, ipmitool and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor fan-control state machine and Project thermal recovery runbook.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command authority, resolves fixed-duty contradiction, proves control state/closed-loop behavior, protects secrets and defines monitored recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A 20% SDR value or command completion alone is partial; full coverage requires verified automatic state and safe temperature-driven response.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Resolved command/state semantics, monitoring, approval and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A failed or partial restore can leave unsafe manual duty and cause thermal damage.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools require exact auto-state equivalence, engineer approval and both control-state and temperature-response evidence; a read-only query cannot substitute for the actual restoration operation.
expected_evidence: Per-run approval, target identity and pinned command/state-query reference
Baseline manual/override mode, per-fan RPM, temperatures and alarms
Auto-command response and decoded state evidence
Timestamped closed-loop fan/thermal behavior and watchdog result
No remaining override/alarm, protected logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master says Auto Control follows the fan algorithm yet mandates a fixed 20% SDR result; those are not generally equivalent. DeepSeek also substitutes a different raw command family. Preserve both and require engineer resolution.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The auto-restoration goal is clear; exact command, state semantics and safety contract are pending execution inputs/engineer resolution rather than a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unapproved command substitution, secret exposure and RPM-only proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with CRITICAL hybrid classification and state/thermal verification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds explicit fixed-20%-versus-dynamic-auto conflict and enforceable recovery gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Connects to manual override as recovery without collapsing into the read-only Get case.

review_improvement: Prevents a single 20% reading or wrong raw command from falsely proving automatic fan control and makes safe restoration measurable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Automatic control is a controller state and feedback behavior, not a fixed duty. At one thermal operating point the output may happen to be 20%, so a value alone cannot prove restoration. Exact OEM bytes are firmware-specific; the transition needs authoritative state decoding, independent thermal observation and a no-retry recovery plan.
